newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA BIRZHU PIPELINE OIL VOLUMES RISE IN JULY.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA BIRZHU PIPELINE OIL VOLUMES RISE IN JULY.

text.p: Lithuania's Birzhu Pipeline said on Wednesday that it transported 2.12 million tonnes of crude and oil products in July and 13.2 million tonnes in the first seven months of the year.
The company transported 1.979 million tonnes of crude and products in June.
The company also said that it transported 8.567 million tonnes of crude to Latvia's Ventspils port in the seven months of the year, 1.293 million tonnes of it in July.
The firm said 2.892 million tonnes of crude were transported to Lithuania's Mazheikiu Nafta refinery in the first seven months and 580,000 tonnes in July.
The company also sent 1.765 million tonnes of diesel to Ventspils in the first seven months and 248,000 tonnes in July.
Birzhu Pipelines is 90 percent stated-owned and had net profits of 13.99 million litas and 42.64 million litas turnover in the first half of the year.
